capabilities: Restyle the editor, sidebars, callouts, tables, and code blocks with five color presets
Insert Markdown components through a slash-triggered menu
Build and edit Mermaid flowcharts visually with draggable shapes
Enter LaTeX equations with an on-screen math keyboard and optional renderer
Export and import plugin preferences as profiles between devices
disambiguation: Not a port of Apple's Notes app; it restyles Obsidian and adds editing tools while notes stay ordinary Markdown.
extras: Development source is kept in a private repository (public repo holds installable JS and guides); the directory may show a clipboard capability advisory for profile export; JSON profile downloads are unverified on iPhone/iPad; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's default look and editing tools differ from Apple-style design, and it lacks a slash insert menu, visual flowchart editing, and an on-screen math keyboard.

relations.evidence: The note stores a normal fenced mermaid flowchart.

summary: Apple-inspired appearance theme for Obsidian bundled with editor tools: slash insert menu, code highlighting, visual Mermaid flowchart builder, math keyboard, and portable profiles.
